title: Portfolio Website
tagline: A modern, responsive portfolio website built with React and TypeScript
overview: A high-performance personal brand hub designed to showcase technical expertise through an interactive UI and integrated blog.
problem: Generic templates failed to represent my specific technical skills in low-latency frontend development.
solution: Built a custom engine using Vite for near-instant HMR and Tailwind for a design system that scales across all devices.
impact: Resulted in 3 high-tier job offers and a 200% increase in LinkedIn profile views within the first month.

architecture.description: Component-based React architecture utilizing Atomic Design principles and deployed via Vercel's Edge Network.

challenges.fix: Implemented image webp conversion and dynamic imports for heavy components.
challenges.lesson: Performance is a feature, not an afterthought.

challenges.fix: Used Framer Motion with useInView hooks to trigger animations only when visible.

roadmap: Add a 3D Hero section with Three.js

title: E-commerce Platform
tagline: Full-stack e-commerce platform with payment integration
overview: A robust commercial solution featuring real-time inventory tracking, secure Stripe checkouts, and an analytics dashboard.
problem: Local retailers were paying 15% commissions to marketplaces, eating their entire profit margin.
solution: Developed a dedicated platform that lowered processing fees to 2.9% + 30c per transaction.
impact: Helped 5 local businesses transition to online-only models, saving them $4k/month in rent.

architecture.description: Microservices-ready Node.js backend with a React SPA frontend and distributed MongoDB clusters.

challenges.fix: Leveraged Stripe Elements to ensure card data never touches our servers.
challenges.lesson: Delegate security to specialists where possible.

challenges.fix: Switched to optimistic concurrency control using version keys.

title: Task Management App
tagline: Collaborative task management application with real-time updates
overview: A Trello-style productivity tool designed for high-velocity teams who need real-time data synchronization.
problem: Existing tools were either too simple or overly bloated and slow.
solution: Utilized Firebase Firestore for real-time listeners, creating a zero-latency feel for collaborators.
impact: Beta testers reported a 25% reduction in project completion time.

architecture.description: Serverless architecture using Firebase Auth, Firestore, and Cloud Functions.

challenges.fix: Implemented Firestore snapshots for real-time global state updates.
challenges.lesson: Real-time sync changes the way you think about local state.

stackDeepDive.aiIntegration: Google Cloud Natural Language for task tagging

title: Weather Dashboard
tagline: Real-time weather application with geolocation support
overview: A data-driven weather portal providing 7-day forecasts and historical climatic data visualizations.
problem: Standard weather apps were cluttered with ads and lacked data transparency.
solution: Created a clean, focused dashboard with interactive data charts using Chart.js.
impact: Gained 500+ daily active users in the first week due to superior UI speed.

architecture.description: Client-side React app with Axios interceptors for API management.

challenges.fix: Implemented local storage caching to minimize redundant external calls.
challenges.lesson: Protect your API keys and your budget.

title: Blog Engine
tagline: Markdown-based blog engine with SEO optimization
overview: A developer-first blogging platform that compiles MDX files into high-speed static pages with perfect SEO.
problem: CMS platforms like WordPress are slow and hard to version control with code.
solution: Leveraged Next.js Static Site Generation (SSG) to serve content directly from the repository via Markdown.
impact: Achieved a 0.8s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) score.

architecture.description: Next.js Static Generation with MDX processing via Contentlayer.

challenges.fix: Integrated Rehype-Prism for beautiful server-side code block rendering.
challenges.lesson: Static rendering beats client-side rendering for blogs.
